risks.title: Dependence on aerospace market and economic cycles
risks.score_rationale: Core documented risk: 'The Company's success is highly dependent on the performance of the aviation aftermarket' and 'lower demand for business aviation and commercial air travel'. Explicit language: 'material adverse effect on the Company's business, financial condition, and results of operations'. 2025-2026 context amplified by geopolitical tensions (Ukraine, Middle East) and volatile macroeconomy. Maximum weighting for structural operational risk directly affecting demand.

risks.title: Customer concentration and credit risk
risks.score_rationale: While not explicitly quantified in provided source, concentrated portfolio dynamics in commercial aviation and MRO imply significant exposure to few major customers. Risk documented by potential 'payment delays' and customer 'financial distress' in case of aviation downturn. Language 'material adverse effect' applied. Weighting at 4 (vs 5) as source does not explicitly detail major customers. Direct credit risk on cash flow remains significant.
